source: MRO HiRISE DEM 1 m, set 1206 (esp_060763_1985_esp_060697_1985_tied-dem.tif), Day et al. 2023 (doi:10.17189/ervc-mr85)

legend.label: 0–5°
legend.why_this_edge: below the 5° hazard-avoidance slope used for landing systems

legend.label: 5–10°
legend.why_this_edge: low to moderate slip expected on loose material (<10°)

legend.label: 10–15°
legend.why_this_edge: slip rises sharply on loose material (10–17°)

legend.label: 15–20°
legend.why_this_edge: upper end of slopes Apollo crews walked; near the 20° suit requirement

legend.label: 20–25°
legend.why_this_edge: at or above the 20° EVA suit requirement; near the Apollo rover design maximum (25°)

legend.label: 25–30°
legend.why_this_edge: above the Apollo rover design maximum; below the 30° Mars rover operating limit

legend.label: 30°+
legend.why_this_edge: above the 30° operating tilt limit of NASA Mars rovers

note: display only. Horn 3x3 slope at a 5 m baseline (DEM block-averaged from 1 m to 5 m, no filling); each overlay pixel (3.5 m) shows the class of its nearest slope value. Slope at a 5 m baseline is not the same quantity as slope at another baseline. Class edges match manifest.severity_classes; approved thresholds are in manifest.thresholds. Transparent = no slope value.
